The order-zero value is the continuous limiting case and equals the weighted geometric mean.
Useful special cases include harmonic mean at order -1, geometric mean at order 0, arithmetic mean at order 1, and root-mean-square at order 2.

items.text: AM-GM allows nonnegative inputs. If all weights are positive, equality holds exactly when all inputs are equal; zero weights simply omit their inputs.
Power means of order zero or negative order require positive inputs. For positive orders, nonnegative inputs are allowed.
Weights are nonnegative and sum to one. Unnormalized positive weights may be divided by their total first.
